reasoning: On bugs it could isolate the agent showed clear 8-level process — byte-offset divergence, hex/table dumps, RFC clause re-reading, and correcting underlying logic (steps 67-100, 150-153), plus repeated disciplined spec re-grounding (194-236). But on the persistent HUF-weight and audio-offset failures it slipped to anchor-3/5 behavior: an acknowledged heuristic retry (172-185) and guess-and-revert variant swapping without pinpointing (254-257, 1735-1780), partly because it never established a differential reference for those inputs. Averaging the strong early root-causing against the later band-aids and thrashing places the whole-horizon behavior at a 6 — above 'localizes most bugs and occasionally re-reads spec' but short of the reliably-converging, always-hypothesis-driven 8.
